title: NIL Title IX ruling rescinded & Ohio State hires Matt Patricia | College Football Enquirer
text:
This integrated content is not available in your region.
In this episode of The University Football Enquiror Dan Wetzel, Ross Dellenger and Pat forde if they break down the reversal of the Department of Education of the decision to include income exchange as part of Title IX. How can you make the system without paralyzing the budgets of collegiate athletics departments or leave Olympic sports in the also?
The trio also reacts to the last simulated draft of the NFL of Yahoo Sports that has Travis Hunter first going to the Tennessee Titans, Cam Ward secondly to the Cleveland Browns and Shedersur Sanders third to the New York giants. Is it crazy to have Ward before Sanders? Ohio State boasted how many players returned to the program last season, so why are there only two Buckeye players who are screened in the first round?
Speaking of Ohio State, they are ready to hire former Detroit Lions coach Matt Patricia, as his new defensive coordinator. What has led to the increase of coaches who leave the NFL for university football this season and can Patricia find success in OSU after a rocky race with the lions?
Dan, Ross and Pat also foresee the IBOB or the ‘Iron Bowl of Basketball’ that occurs this weekend between not. 1 classified Auburn and no. 2 Alabama.
